description: This file defines an AutolockService class responsible for managing automatic application locking behavior based on user activity and focus state, including polling for visibility changes and handling lock intervals.

classes.name: AutolockService
classes.description: A service class extending AbstractService that manages automatic locking, focus detection, and auto-lock timer management based on application events and visibility.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Initiates polling when the application is launched.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Performs cleanup by cancelling timers, unsubscribing events, and calling the superclass deinit method.

methods.name: addAppEventObserverAfterSubclassesFinishConstructing
methods.description: Schedules adding an application event observer after construction.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Sets up an event listener for application launch events.

methods.name: lockApplication
methods.description: Locks the application if a passcode exists, throwing an error if not.

methods.name: setAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Sets the auto-lock interval preference in persistent storage.

methods.name: getAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the current auto-lock interval from storage, defaults to 'None'.

methods.name: deleteAutolockPreference
methods.description: Removes the auto-lock preference and cancels the auto-lock timer.

methods.name: beginPolling
methods.description: Starts periodic polling to check app lock status and document focus state, managing auto-lock timer accordingly.

methods.name: getAutoLockIntervalOptions
methods.description: Provides options for auto-lock intervals for UI selection.

methods.name: documentVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in document focus state, starting or cancelling auto-lock timer as needed.

methods.name: beginAutoLockTimer
methods.description: Sets the auto-lock timer based on the selected interval, calculating the lock time.
